defaults.video_script: Thirty-three points. That was Messi's margin over Robert Lewandowski in the two thousand twenty-one Ballon d'Or. Messi scored six hundred and thirteen points. Lewandowski had five hundred and eighty. Jorginho was third with four hundred and sixty. Lewandowski scored forty-one Bundesliga goals, a league record. Messi had just won the Copa America with Argentina. It was his seventh Ballon d'Or. Who deserved the two thousand twenty-one Ballon d'Or?
defaults.video_subject: Lionel Messi won the 2021 Ballon d'Or with 613 points, 33 ahead of Robert Lewandowski on 580, after the Copa America win, with Jorginho third on 460.
